scope: Only steps 1 and 2 approved. No setup, golden tests, pilot, paid model call, main execution, commit or push has been performed.

generation.transport_retry_condition: Only explicit retryable transport error without usable generation; retain and reserve cost of unknown attempts; no best-of selection

test_budget.assertion_policy: Count actual checks; no equal-assertion-count claim
test_budget.overflow_policy: Stop execution at the common cap; retain output and mark budget_exceeded; no silent truncation of tests
test_budget.sut_reset: Before each original/mutant execution; same pinned harness for both arms
test_budget.instrumentation_error_policy: Do not score cap/infrastructure failures as mutant kills; mark unresolved and block a complete benchmark conclusion until verified.

replication.rationale: Budget-constrained repeated generation; not a power or equivalence guarantee; review and precision gate before main

allocation.algorithm: SHA256 ranking; stratified pilot selection; service/run alternating CI/IC orders; hash interleave; keep each pair adjacent

budget.preferred_local_window: 17:15-07:30 Asia/Saigon; recheck official rates and UTC peak windows before dispatch
budget.admission: Require a validated upper bound for request tokens/cost, reserve at peak miss/output rates, and enforce used+reserved<=3 before dispatch. If bound or price cannot be verified, do not dispatch. Reconcile provider usage; retain reservations for unknown billing. Stop with incomplete status rather than reduce N/R or select outputs.
budget.pair_admission: Reserve both arms and maximum permitted transport attempts before starting a pair; retain unknown charges. Never start a pair whose worst-case verified reservation could exceed USD 3.

review_gates: Actual environment/dependency versions and API parameter support verification
Golden tests and evaluator manifest/missing-output checks
Exact tokenizer/accounting preflight and pilot cost/precision review
Two independent qualitative reviewers and deadline confirmed
Final prompt/config/manifest/schedule hashes locked before main

analysis.primary_estimand: I minus C mean MS_phi over the fixed 106-requirement panel and planned repeated generations
analysis.optional_t_interval: Exploratory/model-based only: mean +/- 4.30265273*SD/sqrt(3); requires independent approximately normal aggregate run differences, not verified by R=3

requirement_bootstrap.purpose: Secondary case-mix sensitivity, not stochastic-generation uncertainty or generalization to all REST APIs
